name.description: The patient's name. Caller-provided text; preserve the supplied name without guessing or correcting it. If empty or unavailable, use "Not provided" in the summary.

age.description: The patient's age in years. Caller-provided whole number; use the supplied value without inference. If unavailable, use "Not provided" in the summary.

gender.description: The patient's reported gender. Caller-provided text; preserve the supplied wording without inference. If empty or unavailable, use "Not provided" in the summary.

symptoms.description: The symptoms reported by the patient. Caller-provided text; preserve the original meaning and do not add interpretation. If empty or unavailable, use "Not provided" in the summary.

symptomsDuration.description: The duration of the reported symptoms. Caller-provided text; describe it clearly without converting or guessing. If empty or unavailable, use "Not provided" in the summary.

email.description: The patient's email address. Caller-provided text; preserve it as supplied and do not validate or infer an alternative. If empty or unavailable, use "Not provided" in the summary.

patientInformation.description: A concise identification line containing the supplied patient name, age, gender, and email. Use "Not provided" for any unavailable or empty value.

reportedSymptoms.description: A concise restatement of the patient's reported symptoms in straightforward language, preserving the original meaning and adding no interpretation. Use "Not provided" if unavailable or empty.

symptomDuration.description: A clear, simple description of the reported symptom duration, based only on the supplied value. Use "Not provided" if unavailable or empty.

generalObservation.description: One brief, factual, neutral observation based only on the supplied information, such as noting that the reported symptoms continued for the stated period. Do not diagnose or infer a cause.

disclaimer.description: A brief statement that the summary is for informational purposes, is not a medical diagnosis, and that the patient should consult a licensed healthcare professional for medical advice.
